written.description: Gathers several separate AI security scans behind one console: the agent, the MCP servers, the skills, the serving infrastructure, and a jailbreak pass against the model itself.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(agent-scan): add Runcrate provider preset (#722)

Add runcrate as an agent-scan provider preset following the established pattern (#697, #706, #720). Runcrate serves open models on an OpenAI-compatible API; open models are free with a GitHub account.

- agent-scan/providers.yaml + agent_scan/core/agent_adapter/providers.yaml (kept in sync): runcrate under openai_compatible, env key RUNCRATE_API_KEY, default model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash plus openai/gpt-oss-120b, zai-org/GLM-5.3 and moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6
- adapter.py: docstring provider list update
- README.md / README_zh.md: Runcrate section + supported provider types entry
- pytests/test_runcrate_provider.py: registry sync, config resolution, authenticated chat for bare ID and runcrate:<model>, and no key fallback

Verified: 75/75 agent-scan pytests pass; both yaml registries byte-identical; Go Tests CI green.
